content.title: Hong Kong Stocks Enjoy Best Start to Year Since 2013
content.summary: Asian stocks jumped on Friday, as artificial-intelligence fervor extended into a new year. In Hong Kong:  The Hang Seng Index rallied 2.8%, in its best start to a trading year since 2013.   Chip stock Shanghai Biren Technology surged over 90% in its trading debut, the latest in a flurry of AI-related listings in the city.

content.title: Baidu chip unit files for IPO, Trump delays furniture tariff hike
content.description:
Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Tesla (TSLA) reporting that both its EV deliveries for the fourth quarter and full-year 2025 fell just short of expectations, Baidu (BIDU, 9888.HK) stock jumping on its chip business filing for an IPO in Hong Kong, and furniture companies Wayfair (W) and RH (RH) getting a shares boost as President Trump rolls back his tariff hike on furniture imports.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
